persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladevasa jayapratāpavovalasa thva sāphuli dayakā juro

notes: Jayapratāpa Vovala (Nevārī vovāla/bovāra = palace wing or courtyard) refers to a royal courtyard in the Bhaktapur palace of King Jayabhūpatīndra Malla where the manuscript was commissioned/produced.
